text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket wins the Japanese<n>Derby, and Biwa
Hayahide is terrified<n>by how easily her friend
renders her<n>calculations meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her numerous calculations,<n>Winning Ticket
and Narita Taishin both<n>have something that keeps
defying<n>her estimations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If so, then we just have to factor that<n>"something"
into the equation. Doing<n>so without knowing what
we're<n>dealing with is reckless, but Biwa<n>Hayahide
comes up with a<n>hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She realizes she lacks the iron will to<n>improve and
asks me to increase her<n>training intensity to avoid
defeat at the<n>Kikuka Sho.
